opinions.text:
C. A. 6th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Justice White, joined by Justice Brennan, would grant certiorari to settle the conflict between the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit and the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit with respect to the proper resolution of the issue involved in this case.
